intro: Captain Shatterskull is a seasoned orc commander stationed at the Mor'shan Base Camp on the northern frontier of the Barrens. Serving as a crucial bulwark for the Horde, he coordinates efforts to repulse night elf forces contesting the border near Warsong Gulch.

p: Positioned at Mor'shan Base Camp along the edge of Ashenvale, Captain Shatterskull serves on the front lines of the Horde's territorial clashes. Beside fellow officers like Kadrak, Shatterskull works to maintain the Horde's foothold against night elf sentinels and Silverwing forces striving to reclaim the borderlands. His post demands relentless vigilance, as the conflict over Ashenvale's timber and ancient lands constantly threatens to spill over into the Barrens.
